svg.title: 01 — Private runtime topology
svg.desc: DEPLOYABLE DESIGN • private data plane • Event Grid admission • Durable processing • human release and HL7. All service icons are unmodified embedded official Microsoft Azure SVGs.

text.tspan: DEPLOYABLE DESIGN • private data plane • Event Grid admission • Durable processing • human release and HL7
AZURE PRIVATE RUNTIME — private endpoints + delegated Function VNet integration
PRIVATE OPERATIONS / OBSERVABILITY — same governed DNS and route reachability
DNS and routes must reach Function PE
Auto gate OR audited human approval
Private blob / queue / table / file endpoints
Durable state, leases, checkpoints, host content
Custom DI role: infer + model/classifier metadata
Integration subnet ID ≠ private-endpoint subnet ID
Private DNS zone resource IDs supplied as inputs
Runner resolves app + SCM private DNS
No public SCM or public data endpoint
Azure Monitor / Log Analytics private zones
All use privatelink zones and private resolution
1. Persist original bytes, then commit ready manifest
3. Event Grid invokes Function; queue is recovery only
4. Read original over private Blob endpoint
6. Validate required HL7 + all outputs, then commit
data ingress, not a claim that the user UI
or Entra identity plane is inside this VNet.
SCM deployments, host-storage access, business-data access, Document Intelligence requests, and telemetry all require private DNS + permitted network routes.

Blue = private workload data flow. Dashed teal = private monitoring association. Cards describe logical services; PaaS services are reached through private endpoints, not deployed into customer subnets.
